grundmann.src: Stage 31 (CITED/DIGITIZED Grundmann 2020 Fig. 3C); Stage 32 red line 271.7 zs

kirpitch_same_data.note: same events as Grundmann 2020; unrefereed preprint; shown as a cross-check only, never combined

liang2024_floor.note: full text and data (ETH Research Collection) not reachable (Nature paywall; ETH 429/500); the paper reports a dipole-quadrupole transition delay, which cannot be mapped to d1 without its formalism. Best case only: sigma(d1) >= 14619 zs.

combined_best_case.note: even granting the He floor with central value 0, the combination is unchanged: |d1| < 485 zs stands

dropped: Rezvan et al. 2024 J. Phys. B 57 145101 (N2 1s, 880 eV): forward/backward MFPAD intensity asymmetry, no timing; large statistical uncertainties at beta = 45 deg
CO 1s at 905 eV, PRL 129, 253201 (2022): intensity asymmetry, no timing
Heuser 2016 He RABBITT (Stage 38): hemispheres along k not separated, so d1 not accessible
Molecular-frame RABBITT (e.g. Nat. Commun. 2021): angle to polarization / molecular axis, not to photon direction; dipole symmetric along k
Chiral forward/backward delays (Nature 2025): dominated by PECD (tens of as); standard-theory term far larger than d1
